METHOD NAME=send_bits CODE=local void send_bits(deflate_state *s, int value, int length) {\n    Tracevv((stderr," l %2d v %4x ", length, value));\n    Assert(length > 0 && length <= 15, "invalid length");\n    s->bits_sent += (ulg)length;\n\n    /* If not enough room in bi_buf, use (valid) bits from bi_buf and\n     * (16 - bi_valid) bits from value, leaving (width - (16 - bi_valid))\n     * unused bits in value.\n     */\n    if (s->bi_valid > (int)Buf_size - length) {\n        s->bi_buf |= (ush)value << s->bi_valid;\n        put_short(s, s->bi_buf);\n        s->bi_buf = (ush)value >> (Buf_size - s->bi_valid);\n        s->bi_valid += length - Buf_size;\n    } else {\n        s->bi_buf |= (ush)value << s->bi_valid;\n        s->bi_valid += length;\n    }\n} FULL_NAME=send_bits SIGNATURE=void(deflate_state*,int,int) ORDER=1
  METHOD_PARAMETER_IN NAME=s CODE=deflate_state *s TYPE_FULL_NAME=deflate_state* ORDER=1
  METHOD_PARAMETER_OUT NAME=s CODE=deflate_state *s TYPE_FULL_NAME=deflate_state* ORDER=1
  METHOD_PARAMETER_IN NAME=value CODE=int value TYPE_FULL_NAME=int ORDER=2
  METHOD_PARAMETER_OUT NAME=value CODE=int value TYPE_FULL_NAME=int ORDER=2
  METHOD_PARAMETER_IN NAME=length CODE=int length TYPE_FULL_NAME=int ORDER=3
  METHOD_PARAMETER_OUT NAME=length CODE=int length TYPE_FULL_NAME=int ORDER=3
  BLOCK CODE={\n    Tracevv((stderr," l %2d v %4x ", length, value));\n    Assert(length > 0 && length <= 15, "invalid length");\n    s->bits_sent += (ulg)length;\n\n    /* If not enough room in bi_buf, use (valid) bits from bi_buf and\n     * (16 - bi_valid) bits from value, leaving (width - (16 - bi_valid))\n     * unused bits in value.\n     */\n    if (s->bi_valid > (int)Buf_size - length) {\n        s->bi_buf |= (ush)value << s->bi_valid;\n        put_short(s, s->bi_buf);\n        s->bi_buf = (ush)value >> (Buf_size - s->bi_valid);\n        s->bi_valid += length - Buf_size;\n    } else {\n        s->bi_buf |= (ush)value << s->bi_valid;\n        s->bi_valid += length;\n    }\n} TYPE_FULL_NAME=void ORDER=4
  METHOD_RETURN CODE=RET TYPE_FULL_NAME=void ORDER=5
